note: Submodule of Group Media. Adds two VBO action plugins of type media - vbo_assign_media_to_group and vbo_remove_media_from_group (provider groupmedia_vbo) - that extend ViewsBulkOperationsActionBase and delegate to the parent groupmedia.attach_group service, letting an operator choose the target group at run time. No config, permissions, routes, or services of its own; its only observable state is the registered action plugins, present only while the submodule is enabled. Requires groupmedia + views_bulk_operations. Introspection cases read the action plugin registry on the live site; the execution case enables the submodule and verifies its VBO action is registered. Baseline: submodule left enabled.

evals.prompt: The groupmedia_vbo submodule provides bulk operations for Group Media. Which Views Bulk Operations action plugins does it add, and what entity type do they operate on?
evals.expected_output: It adds two VBO actions of type media: vbo_assign_media_to_group (VBO: Assign media to a Group) and vbo_remove_media_from_group (VBO: Remove media from a Group).

evals.prompt: Group Media already ships assign_media_to_group and remove_media_from_group core actions. Why would I use the groupmedia_vbo submodule instead, and what module does it require?
evals.expected_output: The core actions store a single fixed group_id per action, so each targets one group. The VBO actions let the operator choose the target group at run time from the View, which scales to many groups. It requires views_bulk_operations (and groupmedia).

evals.prompt: How do I actually make the groupmedia_vbo 'Assign media to a Group' bulk action usable by editors on a media listing?
evals.expected_output: Add a Views Bulk Operations field to a media-based View, enable the VBO: Assign media to a Group action in that field's settings, then select media rows on the View, choose the action, and pick the target group at execution time.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the action plugin registry and give the plugin id of the Views Bulk Operations action provided by the groupmedia_vbo module for assigning media to a group.
evals.expected_output: vbo_assign_media_to_group (provider groupmedia_vbo, type media) in the plugin.manager.action registry.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the available actions and name the groupmedia_vbo Views Bulk Operations action that REMOVES media from a group, and state which entity type it applies to.
evals.expected_output: vbo_remove_media_from_group (provider groupmedia_vbo), an action of type media.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site we want editors to bulk-assign media to groups and choose the target group at run time from a media View. Enable the appropriate Group Media submodule that provides the Views Bulk Operations actions, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the groupmedia_vbo module (drush en groupmedia_vbo -y). This registers the vbo_assign_media_to_group and vbo_remove_media_from_group VBO action plugins in plugin.manager.action.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site we need editors to be able to bulk-REMOVE media from a group (choosing the group when they run the operation) from a media listing. Turn on the Group Media submodule that provides the Views Bulk Operations action for removing media from a group, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the groupmedia_vbo module (drush en groupmedia_vbo -y). This registers the vbo_remove_media_from_group VBO action plugin (type media) in plugin.manager.action.
